1. Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. This petition seeks issuance of direction in the nature of certiorari for quashing the impugned F.I.R. dated 13.10.2024, bearing F.I.R./Case Crime No.0257 of 2024, for the offence under Sections 498A, 494, 308, 313 I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, registered at Police Station Jethwara, District Pratapgarh.
